gap_register.title: Source traversal direction
gap_register.details: A forward traversal from MV_FILE basic:file:ACCOUNT stops immediately because READS_FROM is stored PROGRAM -> MV_FILE. Consumers must reverse this edge to trace data from the source file toward KWDW_ACC.
gap_register.impact: A literal outgoing-edge walk does not produce a source-to-consumer lineage path.
gap_register.evidence: account_table_lineage.json contains KWDW_ACC --READS_FROM--> ACCOUNT and no outgoing edges from ACCOUNT.

gap_register.title: Direct HVR route does not join the accounts-v1 RAW route
gap_register.details: The direct ult_sf_acc channel lands in LOADACCOUNTS_INGEST. The accounts-v1 Airflow/dbt route loads ACCOUNTS_V1__ACCOUNTS from S3/Datalake. The graph contains no evidenced relationship between these separate branches.
gap_register.impact: Do not claim the direct HVR landing table feeds the accounts-v1 RAW table or its public models without configuration or runtime evidence.
gap_register.evidence: The direct branch ends at SNOWFLAKE_RELATION LOADACCOUNTS_INGEST; the S3/Airflow branch loads RAW.ACCOUNTS_V1__ACCOUNTS.

gap_register.title: dbt physical relation continuity
gap_register.details: dbt dependencies connect DBT_MODEL nodes and MATERIALIZES_AS connects each model to a physical relation. The graph does not connect an upstream model's physical relation to the downstream model that consumes it.
gap_register.impact: A model-level path reaches the public views, but a physical-relation-only traversal cannot continue from internal materializations to those public relations.
gap_register.evidence: The public detail and EOD models DEPENDS_ON internal models; their materialized relations are separate nodes with no relation-to-model consumption edge.

extension_notes.selection_rule: Enterprise models are included when their dbt source resolves to an account-slice public relation or when they are transitively dependent on an included model. Their other declared model/source dependencies are retained as context.
extension_notes.source_resolution: DBT_SOURCE declarations are matched to physical relations by normalized schema and table name; database Jinja templates are preserved in source metadata but are not used as the identity key.
extension_notes.caveat: Static repository configuration only; no enterprise DAG runtime state or live Snowflake catalog was queried.
